sloka: त्वम् राजपुत्रीवादेन न्यवसो मम वेश्मनि ।अकीर्तिश्चातुला लोके ध्रुवः परिभवश्च मे ॥२-१२-९६॥
transliteration: tvam rājaputrīvādena nyavaso mama veśmani ।akīrtiścātulā loke dhruvaḥ paribhavaśca me ॥2-12-96॥

translations.english: You lived in my palace under the name of a princess. You have brought me, for sure, unparalleled dishonour and disgrace. Everybody will look upon me with contempt as if I have committed a sinful act.
